executive_summary: On 2020-12-07, observed sessions reached 5,461, representing a 42.0% relative increase over the four-date Monday baseline of 3,846 sessions. Concurrently, the observed session purchase rate declined from the baseline of 1.95% to 1.03%, representing a 0.92 percentage point decrease and a 47.4% relative drop. This corresponds to an estimated purchase session gap of 50.5 sessions, meeting the defined heuristic thresholds for an alert status.
why_no_alert: Although heuristic threshold criteria were satisfied (minimum sessions, purchase shortfall, and relative rate drop) to set the rule-based status to alert, a formal statistical anomaly alert was not triggered or validated because no statistical significance test was performed (statistical_significance_test_performed is false).
